tasks.spec:
You are changing Scene 1A/1B story data in freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp`, run `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit. Never edit storygame/ (DATA plus TESTS only; if a change seems to need runtime code, STOP and report why instead), bench/frozen/, tests/fixtures/continuity_initiative_pre_3c_adoption/, .env, docs/testing-runbook.md. Do not reformat unrelated text or regenerate unrelated generated files.

GOAL. When Kristin recovers the hidden memory card WHILE a patrol officer is inside the house, the officer sees it: a visible challenge appears that same turn and two facts are committed, so later turns and scene 1B can respond. Recovery with no officer inside (before the patrol arrives or after it leaves) is unchanged. Nothing is hidden, confiscated or lied for the player: custody stays with Kristin, and how she answers is free text. Presence is the existing fact `patrol_in_house` (set true by the pacing event patrol_enters_1a at scene turn 5 and false by patrol_leaves_1a at turn 7; the officer npc `patrol_officer` is moved into the kitchen by the same fact). The facts `card_challenged` and `kristin_marked_by_patrol` are already declared in world.yaml and knowledge.yaml.

READ FIRST: data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml items k_sl_1a_b_r0 (the plain card reveal), k_sl_1a_f_r1; storylet-routes.yaml storylet SL-1A-E (realization SL-1A-E-R1, its operations, the new_fact_ids catalog near line 130-170 with used_by_storylets) ; storylets.md SL-1A-E and SL-1A-C; plot.md Scene 1A.4 'The First Threat'; pacing.yaml events patrol_* and pursuit_1b; docs/markdown-story-authoring.md; tests/test_1a_patrol.py, tests/test_1a_back_door_gap.py, tests/test_1a_gap_pointer.py, tests/test_reveal_reach.py (patterns and helpers to reuse); tests/test_1b_spine_prompts.py (how to build a 1B state).

THE DATA.
A. knowledge.yaml: give k_sl_1a_b_r0 `requires: [{fact_id: patrol_in_house, equals: false}]` (it keeps reach_entity_ids [michelle_drawer], its text and evidence unchanged). Add a new item k_sl_1a_b_r0w, a copy of k_sl_1a_b_r0 with these differences only: requires patrol_in_house equals true; source realization SL-1A-E-R2 (same storylet SL-1A-E); a distinct alias (aliases must be unique across items if a lint requires it; use `memory card recovered in sight of the patrol`); statement exactly: An officer saw Kristin take Michelle's memory card and asked what it is.; delivery_text exactly: Kristin's fingers find something taped beneath the drawer. She peels it loose. It is Michelle's memory card, and she pockets it. The officer turns at the sound. "What have you got there?" His hand is already out.; establishes: memory_card_recovered, card_challenged and kristin_marked_by_patrol all asserted true; same action_evidence (including the `the gap`/`that gap` phrases), same entity_ids, same reach_entity_ids, same leak_terms and must_convey (the new delivery text satisfies every must_convey group; the package lints enforce it).
B. storylet-routes.yaml: add realization SL-1A-E-R2 to SL-1A-E: dramatic_intent: Kristin finds the hidden card while a patrol officer is in the house, and the officer challenges her.; operations assert memory_card_recovered, card_challenged and kristin_marked_by_patrol true; helps_transition_triggers [t_1a_1b]; the same protected_knowledge_boundaries as R1. Add definitions for the two new facts to `new_fact_ids` (used_by_storylets SL-1A-E; follow the existing entries and whatever the loader requires for facts used by pacing or knowledge).
C. storylets.md SL-1A-E: add under Possible realizations: While a patrol officer is in the house, Kristin finds the card in plain sight of the officer, who challenges her.; and add to Effects: May set `card_challenged` and `kristin_marked_by_patrol` when an officer sees Kristin take the card.
D. pacing.yaml pursuit_1b (scene 1B, the first realization list): put a new FIRST realization with `when: [{fact_id: kristin_marked_by_patrol, equals: true}]` and text exactly: The pursuers already have a description of Kristin. They are closing in through the park. Keep the existing default realization last and unchanged.
E. plot.md Scene 1A.4: replace the two sentences 'They do not open the drawer, so the card remains undiscovered; they discover and confiscate nothing.' and 'Kristin conceals the memory card and pretends to know nothing.' (one paragraph, in two places) with: They do not open the drawer. If Kristin has not taken the card, or takes it out of their sight, they find nothing. If she takes it while an officer is watching, the officer challenges her, and the patrol's suspicion follows her out of the house. Keep the rest of the beat, including the gate tape sentence, exactly.

TESTS FIRST. Create tests/test_1a_witnessed_recovery.py BEFORE the data, confirm it fails for the right reasons, then make the data pass it. Keep it small and complete. Drive the real engine as tests/test_1a_patrol.py and tests/test_1a_gap_pointer.py do. Cases: (1) with patrol_in_house asserted true (apply world effects so the officer is in the kitchen) and SL-1A-E active, 'Feel under the drawer.' uniquely hands off k_sl_1a_b_r0w, not k_sl_1a_b_r0; after the turn memory_card_recovered, card_challenged and kristin_marked_by_patrol are true, the card's parent is kristin, the officer is still in the kitchen, and the player-visible narration contains the challenge sentence exactly once. (2) Without patrol_in_house (and again after patrol_departed), the same command hands off only k_sl_1a_b_r0 and card_challenged stays unset. (3) Card recovered first, then patrol_in_house asserted: no challenge facts ever appear, r0w is never offered. (4) With patrol_in_house true but Kristin moved to outside_house: neither card reveal is offered (reach) and 'Feel in the gap.' has no handoff. (5) The turn after the challenge, a CloudflareTurnProvider with a stubbed urlopen (as tests/test_pacing_handoff.py does) sends a prompt whose SCENE contains the statement 'An officer saw Kristin take Michelle's memory card and asked what it is.' (6) A 1B state with kristin_marked_by_patrol true shows the marked pursuit text from pursuit_1b and without it shows 'The pursuers are closing in through the park. The pursuit is not over.' (7) snapshot()/restore_snapshot() at the challenge turn restores identical facts and officer parent. No more tests than these.
UPDATE any existing test that pins the old behavior (candidate sets, spine prompt order, storylet realization counts, plot-text pins): allowed and required, with each change listed and justified; do not weaken assertions beyond what the new behavior changes. Regenerate frontend/e2e/spine-expected-reveals.json only if a repo test fails without it.

FINISH: ruff format and ruff check every .py you touched; run the focused tests in the check until they pass; report each old test changed and why, and any lint you had to satisfy.
